purpose: Carry ERDOS-OPEN protected R1+A1 evidence through the mechanical blind-cohort closure gate and recognize only registered deterministic advancement bundles. Mathematical synthesis is never inferred from RESULT/1 validity. The same bounded controller carries the uniquely registered GCL-E2E-CANARY-001 through one-member closure and deterministic fixed-answer advancement.
authority_source: GCL Release Trust GitHub App; short-lived MATHSOLVE-only token
allowed_actions: read protected ERDOS receipts, raw evidence bindings, cohort activation records, and existing closure/adjudication artifacts
run the protected MATHSOLVE cohort-closure builder and validators from an exact main checkout
create or update exactly one registered cohort-closure candidate branch containing exactly one closure JSON artifact
open exactly one ordinary closure PR from that branch to main
after exact-head documentary approval by gcl-council-clerk[bot], request one exact-head protected squash merge
run an explicitly registered deterministic advancement validator on already-protected synthesis/adjudication bundles
report SYNTHESIS_READY_NEEDS_REGISTERED_PLUGIN when closure is protected but no registered mathematical plugin exists
prohibited_actions: execute R1, A1, or S1 sibling work
inspect sibling returns before the protected R1+A1 closure threshold is satisfied
infer mathematical correctness from schema validity
generate mathematical synthesis or adjudication without a registered deterministic plugin
promote literature-dependent claims when S1 is absent
bypass branch protection, rulesets, or documentary review
certify mathematics or create MATHCERT effect
claim parent Erdős problem resolution, novelty, publication, or prize effect

state_semantics.WAITING_FOR_PROTECTED_R1_A1: blind cohort remains closed to sibling comparison
state_semantics.AWAITING_COUNCIL_CLERK_DOCUMENTARY_REVIE: mechanical closure candidate exists but protected merge is blocked by the non-author review rule
state_semantics.PROTECTED_CLOSURE_MERGED: blind evidence barrier is mechanically closed; no mathematics adjudicated
state_semantics.SYNTHESIS_READY_NEEDS_REGISTERED_PLUGIN: closure is protected but mathematical synthesis requires a separate registered reasoning result/plugin
state_semantics.ADVANCED: a registered deterministic validator confirms a protected replay/adjudication/successor bundle

idempotency_rule: A protected valid closure is never rewritten. An already-ADVANCED registered bundle is validated and reported only; no duplicate branch, PR, adjudication, or successor is created.

live_qualification.qualification_scope: Registered deterministic controller execution and protected-merge review barriers only; not mathematical adjudication or claim certification
